description: SYNTHETIC labelled chats for evaluating ScamLens text signals. Hand-written for this project; not real messages, people or numbers. Cases s01-s20/n01-n20 are the original set; x01-x13/b01-b13 were added in F5 (no real brands). expected_rules are hand labels; identifiers are the identifiers a reader would extract. Cases w01-w04 (scam with decoy warning words) and v01-v04 (benign warnings) were added in round 2 G3. Cases j01-j03 (scam with decoy warning words) and j04-j06 (benign warnings) were added in the final round J3, p01-p03 (task_earn reversed word order and two hard negatives) in the final round P2, d01-d04 (two account-hacked security-deposit scams, and two hard negatives: a genuine bank advisory and a rental deposit) in the demo-video round, written after the J3 context fix (regression examples, not a blind test).
watermark: Illustrative demo data - not a real investigation
